data.hook: Jaxson Dart waved to roaring fans at MetLife Stadium after tossing three touchdowns in a 28-20 upset of Dallas. That victory has New York Giants supporters mapping out a hot streak ahead.
data.name: Giants Fans Dream of 6-0 Start After Week 1 Win Over Cowboys
data.summary: New head coach John Harbaugh debuted with the win, as second-year quarterback Dart passed for 230 yards and rushed for 54 more. Fans point to the next five games against the Rams, Titans, Cardinals, Commanders, and Saints as winnable, fueling talk of a 5-1 or even 6-0 record through six weeks. While some caution it's just one game and betting lines favor the Rams by seven, the optimism builds ahead of tougher matchups like Houston in Week 7.

data.name: Cowboys-Giants Rivalry Kicks Off 2026 NFL Season with Odell Beckham's Blonde Return
data.summary: The Dallas Cowboys faced the New York Giants in the first Sunday Night Football game of the 2026 NFL season at MetLife Stadium, marking new Giants head coach John Harbaugh's debut and Beckham's return since 2018. Cowboys fans chanted 'HOW BOUT THEM COWBOYS' while Giants supporters hyped their fresh start, with both teams posting rocket emojis and 'GAMEDAY' excitement ahead of the 8:20 p.m. ET kickoff on NBC. This ninth Week 1 clash in 20 seasons brought classic NFC East rivalry energy, tailgates, and bold predictions from coast to coast.

data.hook: John Harbaugh tackled wide receiver Malik Nabers himself during a walkthrough to prove he could take a hit after nearly a year sidelined by a torn ACL. That bold move set the tone for New York's upset win over Dallas.
data.name: Giants Stun Cowboys 28-20 in Harbaugh's Winning Debut with Nabers' Return
data.summary: The Giants dominated the second half, holding the ball for over 36 minutes and converting nine of 11 third downs to beat the Cowboys 28-20 in their season opener at MetLife Stadium. Jaxson Dart threw three touchdown passes and ran for 54 yards, while Isaiah Likely caught two scores and Cam Skattebo added 81 rushing yards and a touchdown. Nabers caught six passes for 69 yards in his emotional comeback, boosted by Harbaugh's hands-on encouragement, as Dallas managed just two second-half possessions.

data.hook: John Harbaugh tackled receiver Malik Nabers during walkthroughs to build his confidence. 'Never had this before. That’s love coach❤️,' Nabers later said of the hands-on moment.
data.name: Giants Top Cowboys 28-20 in Harbaugh's Debut Win
data.summary: The New York Giants opened the 2026 NFL season with a 28-20 victory over the Dallas Cowboys at MetLife Stadium, marking John Harbaugh's debut as head coach. Second-year quarterback Jaxson Dart shone, completing 23 of 29 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns, while adding 54 rushing yards with no picks. Tight end Isaiah Likely caught all eight targets for 78 yards and two scores, and the Giants converted nine of 11 third downs to control the game. Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott threw for 175 yards and two touchdowns but had an interception in the loss.

data.hook: Isaiah Likely hauled in eight catches for 78 yards and two touchdowns against the Cowboys, giving former Ravens fans a bittersweet glimpse of what might have been.
data.name: Isaiah Likely Shines in Giants Debut, Stirs Ravens Fans
data.summary: The 26-year-old tight end, who signed a three-year, $40 million deal with the Giants in March to reunite with coach John Harbaugh, outshone ex-teammate Mark Andrews in their openers—Likely scoring twice in New York's 28-20 win, while Andrews managed 49 yards without a touchdown in Baltimore's 41-23 rout of the Colts. Ravens supporters shared heartfelt posts, with one saying he's 'the only former Raven I’mma truly miss' and others lamenting the choice to extend Andrews instead. Some countered that Baltimore offered Likely bigger deals, but he left for a starring role; the split highlights how backups often thrive elsewhere in the NFL.

data.name: Giants Kick Off Harbaugh Era with 28-20 Win Over Cowboys
data.summary: New coach John Harbaugh got a statement victory in his Giants debut, beating the Cowboys 28-20 on Sunday Night Football. Rookie QB Jaxson Dart shone with 230 passing yards, three TDs, and 59 rushing yards, while tight end Isaiah Likely grabbed two scores in his first game. Malik Nabers returned strong from a torn ACL, catching six passes for 69 yards, and teammates handed him the game ball in celebration. The defense limited Dallas to 69 rushing yards, fitting Harbaugh's physical style perfectly.

data.name: NFL Fans Celebrate Victory Monday After Wild Week 1 Wins
data.summary: Winning teams like the Buffalo Bills, Jacksonville Jaguars, and Chicago Bears lit up the first week with high-scoring victories, including the Bears' record 59-37 rout of the Panthers—the highest-scoring Week 1 game ever. Fans extended the excitement into Monday with team gear, memes, tailgates, and posts like 'DA BEARS! Victory Monday!!!' Even some losing fans nodded along with 'Happy Victory Monday to those that can celebrate.' The tradition lets victors savor Sunday triumphs before the next matchup.

data.name: Odell Beckham Jr. Returns to Giants with Ovation and One-Handed Catch
data.summary: Beckham reunited with Victor Cruz on the field and made an insane one-handed catch to thrill fans during the season opener against the Dallas Cowboys. Young stars like Cam Skattebo celebrated a touchdown with a backflip, while second-year players Jaxson Dart and Abdul Carter showed sharper confidence in throwback jerseys. Under new coach John Harbaugh, OBJ aimed to prove who he is now, blending nostalgia with the team's fresh energy in the divisional rivalry.
